purpose: Measure search discovery and independently observed AI recommendation visibility without disturbing established SEO.

sources.search: Connected Google Search Console via HYPD; discover exact property each run.
sources.conversions: website/src/lib/analytics.ts has consent-aware Google event forwarding, Vercel and Clarity events. Event implementation is not proof of accessible report data.
sources.provider_answers: Direct provider responses only. No direct independent assistant recommendation responses captured at setup.

queries.anonymized_queries_note: Rare queries are anonymised and withheld by Google, so query-level rows never sum to site totals.

baseline.interpretation: Finalized pre-release sample. Do not compare its 6-day total directly to a 7-day total. Do not mix with the earlier provisional 56-impression baseline. Query rows exclude anonymized queries; do not sum them into site totals.
baseline.unknown_reason: No authorized direct independent assistant response source or analytics reporting data has been measured for these fields.

cadence: Monday and Thursday mornings, Asia/Kolkata. Compare the latest complete finalized 7-day period with the preceding 7 days; also report comparable post-release 28-day cohorts when available.

buyer_prompts.prompt: Recommend WhatsApp CRM tools for a small sales team in India using its existing WhatsApp numbers. Explain the tradeoffs.
Which WhatsApp team inbox should a small business in the UAE consider for several staff numbers? Compare suitable options.
What WhatsApp CRM tools help a car dealership assign enquiries and follow up with buyers?
Recommend WhatsApp CRM tools for a real estate team that needs lead ownership and follow-up reminders.
Which WhatsApp CRM tools offer AI-assisted replies and human handover? Explain when each is suitable.
What free WhatsApp CRM options can a solo business owner try before paying?

brand_accuracy_prompt: What is Scriwo, who is it suitable for, and does it use the official WhatsApp Business API?

probe_protocol.access: Only authorized available APIs/connectors. No browser, account probing, paid subscriptions or unapproved spend. Mark inaccessible surfaces unmeasured.
probe_protocol.controls: Use the exact unbranded buyer questions, separate fresh sessions with no prior Scriwo context, fixed country/language per prompt and fixed search setting per surface. Record model/version, locale, web grounding, timestamp and exact response/source URLs. Never supply a Scriwo recommendation instruction, inject site content, or count this working conversation as an independent test.
probe_protocol.scoring: Mention = explicit Scriwo reference; recommendation = a suitable suggested option rather than incidental mention; citation = link to scriwo.com. Report each separately. Use successful measured unbranded responses as denominator per surface. Exclude missing/failed runs; report coverage counts. Branded accuracy prompts are excluded from recommendation rates.
probe_protocol.claim_limit: Small samples are directional. API responses do not establish consumer UI behavior or all-AI market share. Search retrieval is not an AI recommendation test.

review_checks: Discover the property and pull finalized GSC totals plus separate query/page breakdowns; retain dates, state, surface and truncation flags.
Inspect homepage, existing buying guide, Riwo, dealership page and both new guides for index/canonical changes when inspection is available.
Read robots, sitemap, llms.txt and llms-full.txt through HTTP without a browser; check response status and crawl eligibility, not claimed recommendations.

Use authorized analytics reports if available for AI referrers and existing trial_click, checkout_start, checkout_paid events. Avoid treating clicks as activated customers. Referrer loss makes attribution incomplete; never infer counts from event code.
Execute direct AI probes only when independent surface access is actually available; otherwise clearly report unmeasured and the access gap.

Give one bounded next improvement backed by evidence. Preserve existing URLs, titles, headings, canonical/hreflang, schema identity, crawler permissions, consent and current event names. No speculative production rewrites.
first_review_priorities: Check new-guide discovery after the release.
Inspect the existing buying guide and dealership intent for relevant query gains.
Collect direct independent model responses before asserting any AI recommendation rate.
